homeCats.en: Soak the cut fries in ice water in the fridge for at least 30 minutes (up to 3 days) before cooking; it rinses off surface starch so they crisp without sticking.

homeCats.en: Parboiling the potatoes in alkaline water (with baking soda) roughs up their surfaces into a starchy slurry that roasts into a crunchy crust.

chefs.d_en: Ansel's signature croissant-doughnut hybrid: laminated dough is proofed, fried in grapeseed oil, rolled in sugar, filled with cream and glazed. The flavour changes every month.
